The day of the Satsuki Sho on the Classic 
Triple Crown route. In the grandstands, 
the audience's hearts raced with 
excitement for the fierce battle about to 
begin!

Meanwhile, in the underground tunnel stood 
Mihono Bourbon, full of determination, 
alongside Rice Shower, who admired her and 
yearned to catch up to her.

And standing off to the side, watching the 
two of them, was Matikanetannhauser.

Feeling a slight sense of bewilderment at 
her standing in the wings as if it were 
the most natural thing in the world... the 
Satsuki Sho got underway!
